Heading
* The RFA Grant Accountant will be assigned by the RFA Director, Mr. Jeffrey Copeland, upon receipt of your NOA and completion of your Post Award Briefing.
Complete the content above before moving on.
Knowledge check: Who in the Office of Research Administration would assist you with compliance regarding human subjects research?
  - Ms. Ailing Zhang (Senior Grants Manager)  [incorrect]
  - Ms. Deshun Li (Research Budget Specialist)  [incorrect]
  - Mr. Ryan Mobley (Training and Communications Coordinator)  [incorrect]
  - Dr. Edet Isuk (Director of Research Compliance)  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  Explanation: Great job! Ms. Li
  If correct: Great job! Dr. Isuk is happy to be of service and provide the guidance and necessary review for any research protocols involving human subjects.
  If incorrect: While this person will definitely assist you with other aspects of your project, they do not assist with human subjects protocol review.
